headlines.title: Sweden’s Nordic Air Defence launches K200 drone interceptor, pushes toward Ukraine tests
Sweden spots Russian tank on its own NATO signs
Sweden are learning what Chelsea never learned about Graham Potter
Liquid Energy Design and thyssenkrupp partner to develop twin 100,000-tpy eMethanol plants in Sweden
Sweden's datacentre politics are more complicated than they appear | Sweden

brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Sweden’s Nordic Air Defence has launched the K200 drone interceptor and is pushing toward Ukraine tests. [1]
Sweden has spotted a Russian tank on its own NATO signs. [2]

KEY RISKS
Sweden is linked to 13 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations, as of Nov 24, 2026. [E2]

OUTLOOK
A Polymarket market related to Sweden, "Will Magdalena Andersson be the next Prime Minister of Sweden?", priced Yes at 32% on Nov 24, 2026; it closes Jul 1, 2027. [E5]
A Polymarket market related to Sweden, "Will the next governing coalition of Sweden include M + KD + L + C?", priced Yes at 63% on Nov 24, 2026; it closes Aug 1, 2027. [E6]

WATCH ITEMS
Whether the next governing coalition of Sweden will include M + KD + L + C, as priced at 63% in a Polymarket market closing Aug 1, 2027. [E6]
